question: Compare Shopify and BigCommerce on enterprise e-commerce platforms

findings.evidence: Shopify states that its commerce programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: Shopify platform overview

findings.evidence: BigCommerce states that its commerce programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: BigCommerce platform overview

findings.evidence: Both Shopify and BigCommerce report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts Shopify's in-house delivery with BigCommerce's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: Shopify discloses investment in commerce capability.
findings.evidence: Shopify discloses continued investment in commerce training and certification.
findings.title: Shopify investment disclosure

findings.claim: BigCommerce discloses investment in commerce capability.
findings.evidence: BigCommerce discloses continued investment in commerce delivery centres.
findings.title: BigCommerce investment disclosure

findings.claim: A second source disagrees about the partner model.
findings.evidence: A second source reports that BigCommerce delivers commerce work in-house rather than through partners.
findings.title: Conflicting note

sections.heading: How Shopify and BigCommerce organise commerce
sections.body: Shopify runs commerce through a dedicated unit, while BigCommerce organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both Shopify and BigCommerce report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in commerce capability, though in different places.

sections.heading: Where the sources disagree
sections.body: The two sources disagree about BigCommerce's delivery model: one describes a partner-led approach and the other in-house delivery. Both positions are reported here rather than resolved.

claims.text: Shopify delivers commerce work through a dedicated business unit.
BigCommerce organises commerce work around partner platforms.
Both Shopify and BigCommerce report multi-year platform partnerships.
Shopify and BigCommerce both disclose continued commerce investment.
Sources disagree about whether BigCommerce delivers commerce work in-house.

verdicts.quote: Shopify states that its commerce programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
BigCommerce states that its commerce programme is organised around partner platforms.
Both Shopify and BigCommerce report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
Shopify discloses continued investment in commerce training and certification.
A second source reports that BigCommerce delivers commerce work in-house rather than through partners.
